Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Slayn & Korpil Facilities]]: a close-up of the body copy of an advertisement by The Man's Shop of Salem, Oregon, for the Alligator "weatherstyle" all-wool worsted coat, with the line "It's Alligator, of course, and that means quality." outlined and highlighted. Cropped from the newspaper's full-resolution page scan (JPEG 2000), enlarged three times and sharpened. The whole advertisement is [[:File:Joke reference - Alligator coat ad, Oregon Statesman 1952.jpg]].

Source: ''The Oregon Statesman'' (Salem, Oregon), 10 October 1952, page 4, page scan from [https://oregonnews.uoregon.edu/lccn/sn85042470/1952-10-10/ed-1/seq-4/ocr/ Historic Oregon Newspapers] (University of Oregon Libraries). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027124604/https://oregonnews.uoregon.edu/lccn/sn85042470/1952-10-10/ed-1/seq-4/ocr/ Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a small crop of one advertisement, shown only to identify the real advertising line that the card's lore resembles, beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market.
